The reference image for Green_stem_disorder is an excellent match. Key features align perfectly:

- **Green stem** remaining green while pods have matured and dried to brown/tan
- **Brown, dry, hairy pods** attached to the still-green stem
- **Same background context** (dark soil/debris visible in background)
- The top-right panel of the reference collage is nearly identical to the test image — same angle, same stem-pod relationship, same coloration

This is the classic presentation of Green Stem Disorder: stems remain abnormally green at maturity while pods dry out and desiccate normally (or vice versa — delayed senescence in stems while pods mature).
